Post Calendar

Thirty of your most-downloaded builds, one a day from Oct 12 to Nov 10, 2026. Numbers are from Oct 10, 2026, the same night as your baseline.

How It Works

Every post is editable: click into the title, the date or any of the four texts and type. Changes save in this browser as you go.

When you're happy, Save Schedule File downloads the whole plan as one file you can keep, hand to an AI helper or load on another computer with Load File.

Have An AI Build Your Kit

This is the process behind this planner, written as instructions you can paste into an AI assistant that can use a web browser (for example Claude with Claude in Chrome). Fill in your details, pick what you want done, copy the instructions, and paste them in. The assistant hands back a file you load here with Load File.


  
Good To Know

  
    
    
  • The web gallery search shows at most 24 results at a time, so the instructions search Lots and Rooms separately and merge them. Your in-game gallery (My Profile, sorted Most Popular) shows the same numbers if you'd rather screenshot it.
    • 
    
  • Searching #yourEAid only finds builds whose description includes that hashtag. If yours don't, the assistant searches your build names instead.
    • 
    
  • Stories are written from each build's main picture and your own description. Read them before posting: the assistant can't see every room.
    • 
    
  • Gallery links go at the end of each post so Discord and Reddit show the build's picture automatically.
    •
